9425.t: From ἐξαιρέω (exairéō, “to take out, discharge [cargo], except, bereave [someone] of [something, e.g. life], transcend, claim [someone] as a freeman”) + -σις (-sĭs, suffix forming nouns of action).

9461.t: From ἐπι- (epĭ-, “on, upon; over”) + ἄρχω (ắrkhō, “to begin; lead, rule, command”).

9453.t: From ἔξορκος (éxorkos, “bound by oath”) (from ἐξ- (ex-) + ὅρκος (hórkos)) + -ίζω (-ízō).
